scientific_goal: Repeat genuine frozen-policy online cost measurement across Ubuntu and Windows hosted runners, five counterbalanced timing passes each, using a new development seed cohort. Check robustness and within-host repeatability; do NOT present as multi-independent-hardware qualification when CPU/VM models are unknown.
controls: same full inference identical frozen core
cheap first-hop coded rule on same inputs

timing.report_host_information: GOOS/GOARCH; hosted machines not necessarily distinct physical models
timing.classification: Per host pass only if frozen >=95% accuracy, 15% step saving, 5% median timed wall reduction AND each of five wall passes saves at least 5%; record failure on any OS, don't alter weights.
